system: FISHING MINIGAME (OSU-style ripple clicking) — Crafting-subdisciplines/fishing.py + game_engine.py integration + natural_resource.py loot
summary: Fishing is a modal timing minigame triggered by clicking a fishing-spot resource with a fishing rod equipped. Ripples spawn at random pond positions; each has a fixed target ring (r=40px) and an expanding ring (starts 0, grows at expand_speed px/s). Player clicks a ripple when the expanding ring is within hit_tolerance of the target radius; score per click is tiered (100/75/50/partial>=25) by |current_radius - target_radius|; a ripple auto-misses (score 0) if it expands past 2.5x target radius. Session ends when required_ripples (4-15, reduced by LCK, raised by spot tier) are all resolved. Success = hit_rate >= 0.5 AND avg_score >= 40. Performance = (avg/100)*hit_rate*(1+quality bonuses) maps to 5 quality tiers with reward multipliers 0.8-1.5, further scaled by yield bonuses. On success: spot's JSON drop table rolls loot, quantities scaled by (1 + LCK*0.02)*bonus_mult (min 1 each), XP = tier table (100/400/1600/6400) * bonus_mult, spot depletes and respawns on a timer. On fail: nothing, rod takes 2x durability loss. Rod durability always decreases (1.0 base), reduced by DEF (2%/pt, floor 0.1x) and Unbreaking enchant. All tuning constants live in Definitions.JSON/fishing-config.JSON with identical in-code defaults. Stats: LCK shortens the game, STR widens timing tolerance, rod tier + Efficiency enchant slow ring expansion; titles (fishing_speed/accuracy/rare_fish/yield/luck_stat) and skill buffs (empower/quicken/elevate/enrich) feed the same formulas.
player_facing: Click a fishing-spot resource in world (rendered deep-sky-blue (0,191,255)) to start; generic harvest gating runs first: rod equipped, in range, rod tier >= spot tier, durability > 0 (game_engine.py:3042-3059; entities/character.py:977-989; systems/natural_resource.py:193-194)

Cannot-fish reasons shown as notifications: 'Not a fishing spot' / 'No fishing rod equipped' / 'Need T{tier} fishing rod' / 'Fishing rod is broken' (Crafting-subdisciplines/fishing.py:701-731; game_engine.py:11654-11656)

Modal pond window: 500x400 pond inside a (pond+100)x(pond+150) water-gradient window, pond top-left at window+(50,100); title 'FISHING - T{tier} Spot'; progress bar 'hits/required ripples'; running 'Score: N'; instruction 'Click ripples when rings overlap!'; 'ESC to cancel' (game_engine.py:11669-11821)
Ripple visuals: static cyan target ring (r=40), expanding ring colored white/cyan, red when current_radius > 1.5x target (about to miss), green once hit; 5px center dot (game_engine.py:11741-11773)

Click feedback text at ripple position fading over 1.0s: PERFECT! (100) / GOOD! (>=75) / OK (>=50) / MISS (0) / EARLY-LATE (partial) (game_engine.py:11778-11805; early/late flag from fishing.py:500,518,541)
Clicks anywhere in pond convert to pond-local coords and route to handle_click; all clicks are consumed while minigame active (game_engine.py:2502-2519)

Result is shown as an overlay ('{QUALITY} CATCH!' green or 'FISH ESCAPED!' red, with Hits, Perfect Hits, Avg Score, XP Reward) and requires a click to finalize — the engine's auto-complete path explicitly skips fishing (game_engine.py:11823-11864, 8560-8566, 2503-2507)

After finalize click: '+qty {Material Name}' notification per loot item, '+{xp} XP' gold notification, '{Quality} catch!' or 'The fish got away!', possible 'Title Earned: {name}!' (game_engine.py:11888-11945)
Double-ESC within 1500ms aborts the minigame entirely (no result processing, no durability loss); first ESC shows 'Press ESC again to abandon craft (materials lost)' warning (game_engine.py:708-726)
Minigame update pauses while the metadata overlay is blocking (game_engine.py:8554-8558)
mechanics: TRIGGER: engine intercepts resource click; is_fishing_spot = resource_type == 'fishing_spot' OR substring 'fishing_spot' in resource_type (species ids like fishing_spot_carp) -> _start_fishing_minigame instead of normal harvest (game_engine.py:3049-3059)
SETUP: FishingManager.start_fishing builds FishingMinigame(spot.tier, rod from character.get_equipped_tool('fishing_rod'), stats {luck,strength,agility}, character) then .start() (fishing.py:733-767)
rod_tier = rod.tier, then max(rod_tier, int(rod.statMultipliers['gathering'])) if statMultipliers present (fishing.py:210-216)

BONUS EXTRACTION: titles.get_total_bonus for fishing_speed/fishing_accuracy/rare_fish_chance/fishing_yield/luck_stat; buffs.get_total_bonus(type,'fishing') for empower/quicken/elevate/enrich; first rod enchant with effect.type=='gathering_speed_multiplier' -> efficiency bonus (fishing.py:228-277)

DIFFICULTY - ripples: effective_luck = LCK*(1+title_luck_bonus); required = max(4, int(8 - effective_luck*0.1)); then required = int(required * (1+(spot_tier-1)*0.25)); then clamp [4,15] — note truncation happens twice, tier multiplier applied AFTER the luck floor (fishing.py:313-328)
DIFFICULTY - tolerance: effective_STR = STR*(1+empower_buff); hit_tolerance = min(30, 15 + effective_STR*0.5 + 15*title_accuracy_bonus) (fishing.py:332-343)

DIFFICULTY - speed: rod_speed_mult = max(0.55, 1 - (rod_tier-1)*0.15 - efficiency_bonus*0.75); spot_speed_mult = 1+(spot_tier-1)*0.2; final = max(0.3, rod_speed_mult*spot_speed_mult*(1-(quicken_buff+title_speed_bonus)*0.5)); expand_speed = 80*final px/s (fishing.py:347-368)
DIFFICULTY - pacing: spawn_delay = clamp(1.5 * (1/rod_speed_mult), 0.8, 2.5) — higher rod tier means LONGER gaps between ripples (uses efficiency-reduced rod mult) (fishing.py:371-372)
target_radius fixed 40; max_radius = 40*2.5 = 100 (fishing.py:375-376)
START STATE: ripples=[], index=0, time_since_last_spawn = spawn_delay (first ripple spawns on first update), counters hits/misses/perfect_hits/total_score/scores all zeroed (fishing.py:385-407)

UPDATE(dt): spawn a ripple when active_ripple_count < 2 AND spawned_so_far < required AND time_since_last_spawn >= spawn_delay (then reset timer to 0); spawn position uniform in [margin, dim-margin] = [50,450]x[50,350] (fishing.py:422-427, 447-464)
UPDATE(dt): each active un-hit ripple grows current_radius += expand_speed*dt; if current_radius >= max_radius: deactivate, score 0, misses+=1, append 0 to scores (fishing.py:429-441)
END CHECK: count ripples where (not active OR hit) >= required -> _end_game (exactly `required` ripples ever spawn) (fishing.py:443-445)

CLICK: candidate ripples are active-and-unhit whose center distance to click <= max(current_radius, target_radius) (early clicks inside the target circle always register); nearest center wins; no candidate -> None, click ignored (fishing.py:480-496)

CLICK SCORING: ring_distance = |current_radius - 40|; early flag = current_radius < 40; if ring_distance <= hit_tolerance: score = 100 if <=5 (perfect_hits++), 75 if <=10, 50 if <=15, else max(25, int(50*(1 - ring_distance/hit_tolerance))); ripple marked hit+inactive, hits++, total_score+=score, scores.append(score) (fishing.py:498-534)
CLICK MISS: ring_distance > hit_tolerance -> ripple deactivated (consumed, no retry), score 0, misses++, scores.append(0) (fishing.py:535-550)

END: hit_rate = hits/required (0.0 if hits==0); avg_score = mean(scores) incl. miss zeros; performance = min(1.0, (avg_score/100)*hit_rate*(1 + elevate_buff + title_rare_fish)); success = hit_rate >= 0.5 AND avg_score >= 40 (success threshold ignores the quality bonuses) (fishing.py:552-576)
QUALITY: performance >= 0.9 Legendary x1.5; >=0.75 Masterwork x1.3; >=0.6 Superior x1.15; >=0.4 Fine x1.0; else Normal x0.8; then bonus_mult *= (1 + title_yield + enrich_buff) (fishing.py:578-600)
XP: base from config tier_{spot_tier} (100/400/1600/6400, fallback formula 100*4^(tier-1)); xp_reward = int(base*bonus_mult) if success else 0 (fishing.py:602-606)
RESULT MESSAGE ladder keyed on hit_rate (<0.3, <0.5) then avg_score (<40,<60,<80,<95,else) (fishing.py:634-649)

PROCESS RESULT (on player's continue-click): success -> loot = spot.get_loot(); each (item,qty) becomes (item, max(1, int(qty * (1 + character.LCK*0.02) * bonus_mult))); spot.depleted=True, current_hp=0 (fishing.py:791-809)
LOOT ROLL: per LootDrop include if random() <= chance, qty = randint(min,max) (systems/natural_resource.py:159-161)
FAIL: loot=[], xp=0, durability_loss = 1.0 * 2.0 (fishing.py:820-831)

DURABILITY: applied only if character lacks attr '_debug_infinite_durability' AND not Config.DEBUG_INFINITE_DURABILITY; final_loss = durability_loss * max(0.1, 1 - DEF*0.02) * (1 - unbreaking_value from first 'durability_multiplier' enchant); rod.durability_current = max(0, cur - final_loss); stat_tracker records durability lost / tool broken at 0 (fishing.py:833-857; entities/components/stats.py:120-130)

ENGINE FINALIZE: inventory.add_item per loot, leveling.add_exp(xp, source='fishing'), stat_tracker.record_exp_gained twice (sources 'fishing' AND 'gathering'), record_fish_caught(item, qty, tier, quality_tier.lower(), 0) per item, one FISH_CAUGHT bus event per session (fish_id = first loot item, quantity = sum of all), title check + skill-unlock check, then clear all minigame state (game_engine.py:11869-11957)

RESPAWN: depleted spot ticks time_until_respawn; JSON respawnTime word maps quick/fast=30s normal=60 slow=120 very_slow=300; hardcoded fallback for fishing spots 30/45/60/90s by tier, HP 50/75/100/150 (data/models/resources.py:56-76; systems/natural_resource.py:38-46, 163-165)
data: Definitions.JSON/fishing-config.JSON — all tuning: minigame.pond_dimensions {width:500,height:400,margin:50}; base_difficulty {ripple_count:8,target_radius:40,expand_speed:80,hit_tolerance:15,spawn_delay:1.5,max_active_ripples:2}; scoring {perfect_tolerance:5,good_tolerance:10,fair_tolerance:15,perfect_score:100,good_score:75,fair_score:50,min_partial_score:25}; success_thresholds {min_hit_rate:0.5,min_avg_score:40}; quality_tiers {legendary:{0.9,1.5}...normal:{0.0,0.8}}; stat_effects.luck {ripple_reduction_per_point:0.1,min_ripples:4,max_ripples:15}; stat_effects.strength {tolerance_bonus_per_point:0.5,max_tolerance:30}; stat_effects.rod_tier {speed_reduction_per_tier:0.15,min_speed_mult:0.55}; tier_scaling {ripple_multiplier:0.25,speed_multiplier:0.2}; xp_rewards {tier_1:100..tier_4:6400}; durability {success_loss:1.0,fail_loss_multiplier:2.0}; respawn_times block is informational only (not read by fishing.py)

In-code defaults identical to the JSON, used if file missing/corrupt (fishing.py:75-105); loader path = <root>/Definitions.JSON/fishing-config.JSON, singleton FishingConfig with nested .get(*keys) (fishing.py:37-124)

Definitions.JSON/resource-node-1.JSON — per-species fishing spot nodes, e.g. fishing_spot_carp: category 'fishing', tier 1, requiredTool 'fishing_rod', baseHealth 50, respawnTime 'fast', drops like {materialId:'common_scales',quantity:'several',chance:'guaranteed'}, {materialId:'water_crystal',quantity:'few',chance:'high'} (resource-node-1.JSON:473-505)

Qualitative word maps: quantity few=(1,2) several=(2,4) many=(3,5) abundant=(4,8) default (1,3); chance guaranteed=1.0 high=0.8 moderate=0.5 low=0.25 rare=0.1 improbable=0.05 default 1.0 (data/models/resources.py:14-34)

ResourceType ids (plain strings, NOT an enum): 'fishing_spot' generic (tier 1) + 12 species — T1 carp/sunfish/minnow, T2 stormfin/frostback/lighteye/shadowgill, T3 phoenixkoi/voidswimmer/tempesteel, T4 leviathan/chaosscale (data/models/world.py:68-72, 122-139, 217-230)
Hardcoded loot fallback if node not in DB: FISHING_SPOT -> ('raw_fish', 1, 3) (systems/natural_resource.py:129-134)
Rod item fields consumed: tier, durability_current, durability_max, statMultipliers.gathering (optional), enchantments list of {effect:{type,value}} (fishing.py:210-216, 271-277, 841-850)
constants: Base: 8 ripples, target radius 40px, expand 80px/s, tolerance 15px, spawn delay 1.5s, max 2 concurrent (fishing.py:183-188)
Score bands by |ring-target|: <=5px -> 100 (perfect), <=10 -> 75, <=15 -> 50, else partial max(25, int(50*(1-d/tolerance))) (fishing.py:192-198, 505-517)
LCK: -0.1 ripple/pt, clamp ripples [4,15] (fishing.py:318-328); STR: +0.5px tolerance/pt, cap 30px (fishing.py:332-343)
Rod: -15% expand speed per tier above 1, floor 0.55x; Efficiency enchant value*0.75 extra speed cut (fishing.py:347-357)
Spot tier: +25% ripples and +20% expand speed per tier above 1 (fishing.py:313-314, 360-361)
(quicken_buff + title_speed)*0.5 speed cut; absolute speed floor 0.3x (fishing.py:364-366)
XP by spot tier: 100/400/1600/6400 = 100*4^(tier-1) (fishing.py:603-605; fishing-config.JSON xp_rewards)
Loot qty = max(1, int(qty * (1 + LCK*0.02) * bonus_mult)) — LCK loot factor 0.02/pt, NOT the retuned 0.12 crit constant (fishing.py:798-801)
Durability: success 1.0, fail 2.0x; DEF cuts loss 2%/pt floor 0.1x; Unbreaking (1-value) (fishing.py:788-789, 822, 838-849; stats.py:129-130)
Fallback spot HP 50/75/100/150 and respawn 30/45/60/90s by tier; JSON respawn words quick/fast=30 normal=60 slow=120 very_slow=300 (natural_resource.py:43-46; resources.py:69-76)

UI: double-ESC abort window 1500ms (game_engine.py:715); hit-feedback fade 1.0s (game_engine.py:11785); ripple ring turns red past 1.5x target (game_engine.py:11761); window = pond + (100,150), pond offset (50,100) (game_engine.py:11678-11688)
hazards: ResourceType is a plain-string namespace, not an Enum — code relies on .lower()/substring checks working on str; species ids all contain 'fishing_spot' so the substring gate matches generic and species spots (world.py:68-72; fishing.py:713-716; game_engine.py:3050-3054)
Order of operations in required_ripples: luck floor max(4,...) applied BEFORE tier multiplier, int() truncation twice, then final clamp [4,15] — do not reorder or results shift (fishing.py:322-328)
spawn_delay divides by rod_speed_mult AFTER the Efficiency-enchant reduction — better rods/enchants slow the game's pacing (more time), an intentional coupling (fishing.py:355-371)

Clickable area is max(current_radius, target_radius): a click inside the target circle before the ring reaches it still consumes the ripple, usually as a partial or a miss — early clicks are punished but registered (fishing.py:490-491)
Wrong-time click permanently consumes the ripple (deactivated, scored 0); a whiff outside every clickable circle is free (returns None, no penalty) (fishing.py:495-496, 535-539)
Overlapping ripples resolve to nearest CENTER among candidates, not the one closest to good timing (fishing.py:483-493)
avg_score includes 0 entries for misses AND hit_rate divides by required — misses are double-punished in performance; preserve this (fishing.py:558-571)
exactly `required` ripples ever spawn (spawn gate on current_ripple_index), so hits <= required and hit_rate <= 1 (fishing.py:423-425)
Only the FIRST matching enchantment is used for both Efficiency (speed) and Unbreaking (durability) — break after first match (fishing.py:271-277, 841-847)
rod_tier upgrade via int(statMultipliers['gathering']) truncates (2.9 -> 2) and takes max with item tier (fishing.py:213-216)
Durability skip check is hasattr(character,'_debug_infinite_durability') — attribute EXISTENCE, not truthiness — plus a separate Config.DEBUG_INFINITE_DURABILITY gate (fishing.py:834-836)

fishing-config.JSON respawn_times section is dead data for the minigame — actual respawn comes from resource-node JSON words or natural_resource.py fallback (same numbers duplicated in 3 places) (fishing-config.JSON; natural_resource.py:43; resources.py:69-76)

Fishing result must be finalized by a player click; the engine's generic minigame auto-complete explicitly passes on fishing — porting the auto path would double-complete (game_engine.py:8560-8566, 2503-2507)

Double-ESC abort clears engine minigame state but never calls process_result: no loot, no XP, no durability loss, and the spot is NOT depleted (fishing spot fields also left set only by the completion path — abort path clears active_minigame/minigame_type/minigame_recipe but not fishing_spot/fishing_pond_rect) (game_engine.py:708-726 vs 11952-11957)
FishingManager.can_fish is called twice per start (engine then start_fishing) — harmless, keep idempotent (game_engine.py:11652-11659; fishing.py:744)

XP recorded to stat tracker under BOTH 'fishing' and 'gathering' sources (intentional double-record for analytics), and FISH_CAUGHT bus event uses first loot item as fish_id with summed quantity (game_engine.py:11904-11934)
Success gate uses raw hit_rate/avg_score — elevate/rare-fish bonuses can raise quality tier but can never turn a fail into a success (fishing.py:571-576)

On success the spot is depleted BEFORE the durability branch; generic can_harvest gating (range, tier, durability) already ran at click time via character.can_harvest_resource, so range is enforced only at start (fishing.py:806-809; game_engine.py:3044)
MIN_PARTIAL_SCORE 25 floor means any in-tolerance hit scores >= 25; partial formula uses FAIR_SCORE (50) not GOOD — keep formula shape int(50*(1-d/tolerance)) (fishing.py:517)
